lessons: Open on a number or a contradiction in the first 2 seconds, never on a name or title card.
First scene shows the moving part, not the empty bench.
Vary the hero object each week; don't put the same cylinder in every episode.
Say only claims that two sources agree on; use ranges ('15 to 20 times') when sources differ.
End on one short line that sums it up, then 'Follow for more'.
